from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentExtraction(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document's key extraction fields."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as appearing in the text")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The 'cause of action' (案由) explicitly stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates extractions from the document stream."""
    judgments: list[JudgmentExtraction]
